tools.name: store_catalog
tools.description: List everything for sale at dacix.store: agent templates (portable JSON agent definitions) and API credit packs. No auth needed.

tools.name: store_register
tools.description: Create a DACIX account and get an API key (dacix_sk_...) plus free trial credits. Store the key — it authenticates every other tool here.

api_key.description: Your DACIX API key (dacix_sk_...). Get one with store_register.

tools.name: ro_company_list

api_key.description: Your DACIX API key (dacix_sk_...). Get one with store_register.

tools.name: classified_categories
tools.description: Category tree of micapublicitate.online (Romanian classifieds) — pick a category_id before posting an ad. Free.

tools.name: post_classified_ad
tools.description: Publish a real classified ad on micapublicitate.online (Romanian classifieds, 30-day listing, free listings only). Returns the public URL. 20 credits, charged only when the ad is accepted. Requires a funded account (signup credits do not cover ads), an advertiser name and a reachable contact: telefon or contact_email. Each DACIX customer posts under their own classifieds account.

api_key.description: Your DACIX API key (dacix_sk_...). Get one with store_register.

description.description: Ad text, plain or simple HTML (min 30 chars)

website.description: Link shown on the ad (optional, no placeholder domains)

nume_contact.description: Advertiser name shown on the ad

telefon.description: Phone shown on the ad, e.g. +40721234567

tools.name: city_info
tools.description: Practical civic info for 28,674 cities worldwide as clean markdown (from rules.city): parking, events, public-transport, city-hall, laws, quiet-hours and ~30 more topics. 5 credits.

api_key.description: Your DACIX API key (dacix_sk_...). Get one with store_register.

city.description: City slug, e.g. berlin or cluj-napoca

topic.description: Topic slug, e.g. parking, events, public-transport
